spec.description: Summary of all cluster-smi nodes and their GPUs.

spec.title: Offline
spec.description: Nodes that have not reported within the router's timeout. Their GPUs are not counted elsewhere.

spec.expr: avg(100 * cluster_smi_gpu_memory_used_bytes / cluster_smi_gpu_memory_total_bytes and on (node, gpu) cluster_smi_gpu_busy == 1)

spec.title: GPU Utilization - Per Server Average (of busy GPUs)

spec.expr: avg by (node) (avg_over_time(cluster_smi_gpu_utilization_percent[$smoothing]) and on (node, gpu) cluster_smi_gpu_busy == 1)

spec.title: GPU Memory Utilization - Per Server Average (of busy GPUs)

spec.expr: avg by (node) (100 * avg_over_time(cluster_smi_gpu_memory_used_bytes[$smoothing]) / avg_over_time(cluster_smi_gpu_memory_total_bytes[$smoothing]) and on (node, gpu) cluster_smi_gpu_busy == 1)

spec.title: Users
spec.description: Users with processes on GPUs right now. GPU util and GPU memory util are averages over the GPUs the user has processes on. They are measured per GPU, not per process, so they are shared with other users on the same GPU. Own memory share is the user's memory divided by the total memory of those GPUs.

spec.expr: count by (user) (count by (user, node) (count by (node, gpu, name, user) (cluster_smi_gpu_user_memory_used_bytes)))
count by (user) (count by (node, gpu, name, user) (cluster_smi_gpu_user_memory_used_bytes))
avg by (user) (cluster_smi_gpu_utilization_percent * on (node, gpu) group_right count by (node, gpu, name, user) (cluster_smi_gpu_user_memory_used_bytes))
avg by (user) ((100 * cluster_smi_gpu_memory_used_bytes / cluster_smi_gpu_memory_total_bytes) * on (node, gpu) group_right count by (node, gpu, name, user) (cluster_smi_gpu_user_memory_used_bytes))

100 * sum by (user) (cluster_smi_gpu_user_memory_used_bytes) / sum by (user) (cluster_smi_gpu_memory_total_bytes * on (node, gpu) group_right count by (node, gpu, name, user) (cluster_smi_gpu_user_memory_used_bytes))

spec.title: GPUs in Use per User
spec.description: Number of GPUs on which each user has processes.

spec.expr: count by (user) (count by (node, gpu, name, user) (cluster_smi_gpu_user_memory_used_bytes))

spec.title: Stacked GPU Power Usage per Server
cluster-smi: GPU Summary

spec.label: Smoothing
